profile_text.body:
UiPath is a publicly traded enterprise software company founded in 2005 and headquartered in New York, NY, trading on the New York Stock Exchange under the ticker PATH (CIK 0001734722). The company describes itself as providing a platform for business orchestration and automation, positioning its technology as bringing together AI agents, automation, people, and systems on a single platform so that work can move faster while remaining governed and producing measurable outcomes.

The company's core product, tracked on this site as UiPath AI, combines robotic process automation with AI capabilities including document understanding, process mining, and enterprise automation governance. The company's own site describes purpose-built agentic solutions that orchestrate and automate critical business workflows, as well as tooling that brings agentic AI to software testing, covering design, automation, execution, and orchestration. The site emphasizes that every action and decision is captured in a complete business record to support scaling AI and automation with confidence.

The held facts show a notable legal footprint, with 299 cases recorded in New York, though no specific litigation details are included in the available data. No MCP server registrations are on record for the company.
